description_en: Queries the details of a resource diagnostic report
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-diagnostic-report-attributes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --report-id dr-i-uf6i0tv2refv8wz00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

Attributes.description_en: The extended attributes of the diagnostic report

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the diagnostic report was created

EndTime.description_en: The end time. This parameter was specified when you called the [CreateDiagnosticReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442490.html） operation to create the diagnostic report
EndTime.description_zh: 结束时间。调用[CreateDiagnosticReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442490.html）接口创建诊断报告时传入的参数

FinishedTime.description_en: The time when the diagnostic report was completed

RepairStatus.title_en:
修复状态，执行修复操作后有值。取值范围：
InProgress：修复中。
Failed：修复失败。
Finished：修复完成。
RepairStatus.title_zh:
修复状态，执行修复操作后有值。取值范围：
InProgress：修复中。
Failed：修复失败。
Finished：修复完成。

Repairable.title_en: 是否可自动化修复：false-不可修复，true-可修复
Repairable.title_zh: 是否可自动化修复：false-不可修复，true-可修复

MetricSetId.description_en: The ID of the diagnostic metric set

ReportId.description_en: The diagnostic report ID. The unique identifier of the resource diagnostic report
ReportId.description_zh: 诊断报告ID。资源诊断报告的唯一标志

ResourceType.description_en: The resource type. The supported type is instance
ResourceType.description_zh: 资源类型。支持的类型为instance

Severity.description_en:
The severity level of the report. This value represents the most severe level among all metrics. The severity levels in ascending order are:

Unknown: The initial state, which indicates that the diagnosis has not started or the diagnosis process exited abnormally. No diagnostic conclusion is available.
Normal: The diagnosis is normal. No issues were found.
Info: Related information is available and may be associated with an exception.
Warn: Related information is available and may cause an exception.
Critical: A critical exception exists
Severity.description_zh:
报告严重等级。所有指标中最严重的等级，严重等级由轻到重如下：

Unknown：初始状态，表示未开始诊断或者诊断过程程序异常退出，无诊断结论。
Normal：诊断正常，没有发现问题。
Info：有关联信息，可能与异常相关。
Warn：有关联信息，可能导致异常。
Critical：有关键异常

StartTime.description_en: The start time. This parameter was specified when you called the [CreateDiagnosticReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442490.html） operation to create the diagnostic report
StartTime.description_zh: 开始时间。调用[CreateDiagnosticReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/442490.html）接口创建诊断报告时传入的参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the diagnostic report. Valid values:

InProgress: The diagnosis is in progress.
Finished: The diagnosis is complete.
Failed: The diagnosis failed
Status.description_zh:
诊断报告状态。可能值：

InProgress：诊断中。
Finished：诊断完成。
Failed：诊断失败
